method: one mutant per named guard, each restored from bytes captured at start and re-verified by sha256 plus a clean re-run of the same test

mutants.claim_under_test: a page that stops at a gap still reports how far the window was observed
a partially rendered page still seals its verified prefix

note: A mutant that cannot be anchored is reported as anchor-missing, which is an UNTESTED guard, not a pass. Survivors here would mean the new tests do not actually watch the behaviour they claim.
